question: Can confidence-bounded online scenario search improve closed-loop delivery over blend_0.5, and what is the shallowest sufficient rollout depth in {1,2,3}?
scope: Model-based online orderer on the three fixed EXP-0039/0040 topologies; no GNN training and no unseen-topology claim.

params.candidate_action: +1.0 logit to one eligible producer for one contested stream
params.ambiguity_gate: search only when the top-two blend_0.5 eligible-producer probabilities differ by <=0.25
params.confidence: unique top action; paired normal lower bound with z=1.645 beats every alternative; producer override mean gain >=0.25 consumer units
params.fallback: blend_0.5 for dominant, exact-zero, confidently-base, or unresolved-at-K16 streams

gate.death_rate: must not exceed paired blend_0.5 on any task
gate.promotion: the smallest depth satisfying every gate

compute: RunPod CPU; one baseline plus three search arms over 30 paired episodes, parallelized by episode. Seed s29/3300 was used for a local engineering benchmark and excluded from the registered gate before pod launch; smoke uses non-gating seed 3299.
